name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The user aims to accurately record and monitor various physical activities, both automatically and manually, to maintain a complete log of their exercise habits.
The user seeks clear and insightful visualizations of their fitness data to easily track progress, identify trends, and stay motivated through achievement notifications.
The user desires the ability to define, customize, and track specific fitness goals to provide direction and maintain focus on their personal fitness journey.
The user expects to receive personalized workout recommendations that adapt to their fitness level and preferences, helping them optimize their training and achieve desired outcomes.
The user wants to effortlessly connect their wearable devices to the application for automatic, real-time syncing of fitness data, ensuring up-to-date and accurate information.
The user aims to share their fitness achievements and activities on social media to engage with their network, celebrate milestones, and foster a sense of community and motivation.
The wearable device's goal is to reliably collect and transmit fitness data (e.g., heart rate, steps, calories) to the application automatically and in real-time.
The wearable device aims to establish and maintain a stable connection with the fitness application to ensure consistent and uninterrupted data synchronization.
lowLevelGoals: The user can start an automatic activity tracking session through an API call.
The user can add a new activity record by providing its type, duration, and intensity through an API call.
The user can fetch all activity logs within a given date range using an API call.
The user can modify existing activity details like duration or calories burned through an API call.
The user can remove an activity record using an API call.
The user can fetch summarized activity data for different time periods (daily, weekly, monthly) using an API call.
The user can fetch historical fitness metrics for a defined time frame using an API call.
The user can request and display visual charts of fitness trends through an API call.
The user can set up and get alerts when fitness milestones are reached through an API call.
The user can compare their current fitness performance with past data or personal records using an API call.
The user can create a new fitness goal by specifying a target metric and a deadline through an API call.
The user can fetch all their active and completed fitness goals using an API call.
The user can modify the target or deadline of an existing fitness goal through an API call.
The user can change the status of a fitness goal to completed or archive it using an API call.
The user can request and receive tailored workout suggestions based on their fitness data and goals through an API call.
The user can modify their preferences for workout recommendations, such as intensity or duration, using an API call.
The user can fetch detailed guides and visual aids for recommended exercises through an API call.
The user can submit feedback on workout recommendations to improve future suggestions using an API call.
The user can start the connection process with a new wearable device through an API call.
The user can check if their paired wearable devices are currently connected using an API call.
The user can force a data sync from a connected wearable device using an API call.
The user can remove a paired wearable device through an API call.
The user can post an activity or achievement to a chosen social media platform using an API call.
The user can adjust who sees their shared fitness content through an API call.
The user can link their fitness application account to different social media platforms using an API call.
The user can see a stream of fitness activities shared by their friends within the application through an API call.
The wearable device must gather raw data from its sensors continuously through its internal API.
The wearable device must convert raw sensor data into actionable fitness metrics using its internal API.
The wearable device must temporarily save fitness data before sending it to the application using its internal API.
The wearable device must send processed fitness data to the application instantly through its external API.
The wearable device must create a secure BLE connection with the fitness application using its communication module.
The wearable device must automatically find and re-establish connection with the fitness application if disconnected, using its communication module.
The wearable device must inform the fitness application about its connection status through its communication module.
The wearable device must accept configuration settings from the fitness application, such as tracking mode, through its communication module.
